PR-B SCOPE PROPOSAL — three deliverables:

[B1] SYMMETRIC WRITE in brain.remember() (neural-engram.ts)
- Every remember() writes to BOTH right (existing NeuralEngramSystem WM+hippo) AND left (KnowledgeStore.write).
- Right write is sync (in-process Map). Left write awaits durable-local persist (LocalStorageProvider) then fire-and-forgets Firestore mirror.
- Source enum populated from remember() callsite: conversation | tool-call | bridge | remember (default).
- Failure isolation: left-write failure logs warn, does not throw out of remember() — right write must always succeed (eidetic on best-effort left + perfect-recall on right working memory).

[B2] CONVERSATIONAL-CHAT POST-LLM REMEMBER (conversational-chat.ts)
- After LLM response returns, before the function exits: two remember() calls.
  - brain.remember(userText, { tags: [eric, conversation, input], source: conversation })
  - brain.remember(mollyResponseText, { tags: [molly, conversation, output], source: conversation })
- Importance: default. Channel context (voice vs text) added to tags if available.
- This is the gap I flagged in the audit — conversational-chat had ZERO post-LLM writes, the smoking gun.

[B3] TESTS (inline per PR per locked consensus)
- neural-engram.test.ts: remember() writes to both stores (mock KnowledgeStore, assert .write called with the engram + correct source enum)
- neural-engram.test.ts: left-write failure does not break remember() (mock .write to throw, assert remember still returns engram, assert warn logged)
- conversational-chat.test.ts (if exists, else create minimal): asserts 2 brain.remember calls per chat turn with correct tags + source
